text: Procedure: Left hemicolectomy with en bloc resection of liver segments 6 and 8. FINDINGS: Descending colon tumor as described, adherent to lateral abdominal wall. Two liver metastases in segments 6 (2.5 cm) and 8 (1.8 cm), both amenable to wedge resection. No peritoneal disease. No additional liver lesions on intraoperative ultrasound. PATHOLOGY (preliminary): Tumor invades through muscularis propria into pericolonic tissue. 3 out of 18 lymph nodes positive for metastatic disease. Liver metastases confirmed. Final staging: pT3N1bM1a. Margins negative. Patient tolerated procedure well, transferred to surgical ICU in stable condition.
